topic: Short sight vs long sight: what minus and plus power mean

youtube.title: Minus or plus power? Short vs long sight 👓 #Shorts
youtube.description:
-2.00 or +2.00: which one means short sight?
மைனஸ் பவர், பிளஸ் பவர்: எது கிட்டப்பார்வை, எது தூரப்பார்வை?

• Minus (−) power = short sight (myopia): near is clear, far is blurry
• In myopia the eyeball is a little too long, so light focuses in front of the retina
• Plus (+) power = long sight (hyperopia): the eye is a little short, so close work is a strain
• Short sight is becoming much more common in children worldwide
• Studies show daily outdoor time in daylight lowers children's risk
• Check children's eye power every year; if it rises fast, see an eye specialist

gmb.text: What do minus and plus mean on a glasses prescription? Minus power means short sight (myopia): near things are clear but far things like the board or road signs look blurry, because the eyeball is a little too long and light focuses in front of the retina. Plus power means long sight (hyperopia): the eye is a little short, so close work is a strain and a plus lens adds focusing power. Short sight is becoming more common in children around the world, and studies show that time outdoors in daylight lowers the risk. Send children out to play every day, check their eye power every year, and wear glasses as prescribed. If a child's power rises quickly, see an eye specialist.
